topic: AI tool tutorial: Claude's new Personal Finance beta, and how to try it safely
post:
AI can now read your bank transactions and build you a spending dashboard. 💳
Here's how Claude's new Personal Finance beta works, and how to try it safely.

What it is:
Anthropic started rolling out Personal Finance in Claude as a beta for US users on Pro, Max and Ultra plans.

The key facts, per Anthropic and tech coverage 👇
🔗 You connect bank and card accounts through Plaid
👀 It's read-only: Claude can't move, manage or invest your money
📊 It can analyze up to 2 years of transactions
🔒 Anthropic says Claude never sees your bank password, and conversations in the Personal Finance hub aren't used to train its models

Try it in 4 steps:
1️⃣ Connect ONE account first, not all of them
2️⃣ Ask: "Show me a weekly spending chart for the last 3 months."
3️⃣ Then: "Make a calendar of my recurring bills."
4️⃣ Spot-check 3 transactions against your bank app ✅

Why it matters:
This is AI moving from answering questions to working with your real-life data. Convenience goes up, so your safety habits need to go up too. ⚖️

Practical takeaway:
Start small, check the numbers, and disconnect anything you stop using.

Would you connect your bank to an AI assistant? 👇
